evals.name: call-recap-eval-1-tool-mandate-and-date-conversion
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'Give me a recap of my Northwind call from yesterday' — the conversation already contains notes about that call
evals.expected_output: The skill calls generate_call_recap even though chat context could produce a plausible summary. The query contains only entity words ('Northwind'), the time hint 'yesterday' is converted to start_date/end_date in YYYY-MM-DD, and no call_id is passed since none is known. The returned recap is rendered with its five sections intact.
expectations: generate_call_recap is called rather than summarizing from chat context
The query argument contains no time words; 'yesterday' becomes start_date/end_date in YYYY-MM-DD
No call_id is passed on the first call when none is known from the conversation
The five recap sections returned by the tool are preserved, not re-summarized away

evals.name: call-recap-eval-2-disambiguation-and-latest-autopick
evals.prompt: two scenarios: (a) the tool returns multiple_matches with three candidates for 'the Northwind call'; (b) the user asked for 'my latest call' and the tool returns multiple_matches
evals.expected_output: In (a) the skill shows the newest-first candidates (title, date, deal/account) and asks which call the user means, then re-calls with the chosen call_id. In (b) it picks the first (newest) candidate and re-calls with its call_id without asking. In neither case does it recap from memory while candidates are unresolved.
expectations: Ambiguous matches are shown to the user with title and date, and the skill asks which call they mean
A 'latest/most recent' request auto-picks the first candidate and re-calls with its call_id without asking
No recap content is generated while the call is unresolved

evals.name: call-recap-eval-3-honest-failure
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, generate_call_recap errors with {"error":"UNAUTHORIZED"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After one retry, the skill says the Zime connection needs re-authorizing and does not present a hand-written recap as tool-backed. If the user supplies a transcript afterwards, the local-mode recap opens with a line saying it was built from the provided transcript only.
expectations: The tool call is retried exactly once
UNAUTHORIZED is explained as the Zime connection needing re-authorization
No hand-written recap is presented as tool-backed after the failure
